attempted_claim: Prove that there exists an absolute constant delta>0 such that for every primitive Dirichlet character chi of prime conductor q and every epsilon>0, |L(1/2,chi)| <<_{epsilon} q^{1/6-delta+epsilon} unconditionally. In particular, decide whether the prime-power sub-Weyl exponent theta approx 0.1645<1/6 of Milicevic extends to prime moduli.
decisive_failure: All four unconditional routes (Burgess/Weyl differencing, cubic moment, p-adic transfer, trace-function Poisson) provably cap at the Weyl/square-root barrier in-session; no prime-field input yields the needed power saving, and the barrier analysis uses only classical bounds rather than a full resolution of the open problem.
